decisions.notes: CWE-124 present selects a socket error condition and recv as bound/sink, omitting the negative destination index or pointer offset required for a buffer underwrite.
CWE-127 present selects a socket status condition and recv as bound/sink, not the negative source index and out-of-bounds read.
CWE-457 not_observed cites a five-iteration initialization loop and a ten-iteration read loop, which exposes the vulnerable partial-initialization relation rather than a fixed relation.
CWE-690 present assigns the same malloc operation both source and sink roles and omits the unchecked dereference or use.
CWE-690 not_observed links a null guard and allocation back to the allocation as sink instead of the dereference constrained by the guard.
CWE-124 present treats an unrelated printIntLine call as the bound for an indexed write and omits the index-producing negative relation.
